hypothesis.statement: The 44-journey registry governance/27_FULLSTACK_MULTI_SURFACE_JOURNEY_REGISTRY.md already contains real, maintained per-journey owner, decision, and candidate-surface text; mechanically parsing it (index table plus per-journey sections) rather than stubbing populated:false lets capability-graph.json be populated with real, traceable product_model_node entries without fabricating any deeper chain link.

intendedChanges: Rewrite inventory-capabilities.mjs to parse the registry's index table and per-journey sections for owner/title/decision/candidate-surfaces, handling backtick tokens plus known idiom phrases ("جميع الأسطح ذات تسجيل الدخول", "التطبيقات الأربعة").

Transform the parsed output into one product_model_node per (journey, surface) pair in governance/remediation/capability-graph.json, keeping population: PROGRESSIVE_P1A (not claiming full-chain completion).
Backfill governance/remediation/requirement-traceability.json with links for every requirement this session's real gaps (GAP-0001, GAP-0002, GAP-0004, GAP-0005, GAP-0006, GAP-0007) addressed.
Honestly omit JRN-043 and JRN-044 (no resolvable backtick-quoted surface token) rather than fabricate a binding, and register that omission as GAP-0007.
expectedOutcomes: node tools/remediation/discovery/inventory-capabilities.mjs produces real owner/title/decision/surfaces for all 44 journeys.
node tools/guards/remediation-governance-gate.mjs exits 0 with capability-graph.json containing 122 schema-valid nodes.
requirement-traceability.json links resolve to real, already-closed or already-tracked gaps only.
forbiddenChanges: Fabricating actor/step/state/action/controller/api_operation/domain_command/repository/database_effect/event_outbox/readback_surface/error_behavior chain links not verified against real code.
Force-mapping a surface for JRN-043 or JRN-044 without registry-text evidence.

unexpectedResults: The gate initially failed with TASK_CONTRACT_WITHOUT_LEDGER_ENTRY for GAP-0008 itself, because the ledger entry for this very task had not yet been added when the contract was first written; added the GAP-0008 ledger entry in the same iteration before re-running.

JRN-002, JRN-023, and JRN-033 use descriptive idiom phrases ('جميع الأسطح ذات تسجيل الدخول', 'التطبيقات الأربعة') instead of a full backtick-quoted surface list; the parser's idiom table resolves these to their intended surface sets, verified by spot-checking the rendered nodes against the source registry text.

newFindings: JRN-043 and JRN-044 have no backtick-quoted candidate-surface token in the registry (JRN-043 describes 'the repository, GitHub, and build/release environments' in prose; JRN-044 is OUT_OF_SCOPE_FOR_THIS_JOURNEY with no candidate-surfaces line at all), so capability-graph.json correctly has no nodes for either; tracked as GAP-0007 rather than silently accepted or fabricated.

regressionTestsNeeded: inventory-capabilities.mjs has no unit test of its own yet; a future iteration should add node --test coverage for parseIndexTable/parseJourneySections/extractSurfaces against a small fixture registry excerpt.
blindSpotsFound: capability-graph.json's population currently covers only domain/journey/surface/decision from the registry index and per-journey heading; the deeper 17-link chain (actor through evidence) remains genuinely unpopulated and is not claimed to be — population stays PROGRESSIVE_P1A, not POPULATED.
